name: Map & Trail-Cam Vision Analysis
description: Analyzes aerial/topo screenshots or trail-cam photos with multimodal vision, cross-references camp wind & GIS data, and saves removable tactical annotations to the live Leaflet map.

phases.name: Phase 1: ReAct Multimodal Map & Trail-Cam Analysis
phases.prompt_template:
Execute the Field & Water Map & Trail-Cam Vision Analysis workflow.

INPUTS:
- Primary photo: {{params.image_path | {{primary_image}}}}
- Extra photos: {{extra_images}}
- Camp / Property context: {{params.camp | Field Map Analysis}} (property_id: {{params.property_id | 1}})
- Output artifact path: {{result_path}}

MANDATORY EXECUTION STEPS:
1. Call `vision_analyze` on `{{params.image_path | {{primary_image}}}}` to inspect the image accurately (whether it is a hunting aerial/topo map, trail-cam photo, or lake bathymetric/shoreline chart — stay strictly faithful to what is actually in the image!).
2. Cross-reference with `hunt_plan`, `hunt_fish`, or `hunt_weather` as appropriate for the image domain.
3. Call `hunt_plan_save` (action="save", property_id={{params.property_id | 1}}) to preserve your visual analysis briefing AND attach removable GeoJSON map annotations onto the live Leaflet map.
4. Write structured JSON to `{{result_path}}` via `file_write` with keys:
   `workflow`, `plan_id`, `camp_name`, `visual_findings`, `recommended_stand_spots` (list), `access_routes` (list), `annotations` (list), `wind_notes`, and `briefing_markdown`.
5. Call `milestone_complete` and deliver a crisp tactical summary of the map/photo analysis.
